scenes.title: Context is control.
narration: Hermes on Herdr.
scenes.visual: A minimal opening plate: the original product mark, a short title, and one coral signal line. Fixed published Hexly fonts and tokens.

scenes.title: Messages ≠ control.
narration: An independent Hermes can receive your messages.
But it does not automatically inherit your Herdr session's pane, socket, or caller context.
qualifications: An external instance needs those relationships configured separately.
scenes.visual: Official Hermes and Herdr marks face a visible gap. Pane, socket and caller context stay inside a crisp unfilled session outline. A signal stops at the missing link.

scenes.title: Brilliant agents.
narration: You trust brilliant coding partners: Codex, Grok, Pi, Claude Code.
As your workflow grows, coordination becomes the job.
scenes.visual: Official Codex, Grok, Pi and Claude Code icons settle into a line. Colored task paths untangle around them, showing the coordination burden.

scenes.title: Choose. Trust. Connect.
narration: The plugin makes the link explicit.
Choose a dedicated Hermes profile you trust, and bind it to your current Herdr session.
qualifications: Existing configured profile · explicit owner binding
scenes.visual: The chosen Hermes mark moves into the current-session outline. A coral path joins Hermes to Herdr; pane, socket and caller labels appear together.

scenes.title: Your manager’s manager.
narration: Hermes becomes your M2, with full Herdr control in the bound session.
It manages Herdr. Herdr coordinates your coding agents.
qualifications: Full control of the bound session, under Herdr and plugin checks
scenes.visual: An editorial diagram connects Hermes M2 to Herdr manager, then branches to four real coding-agent marks. Moving dots convey task delegation.

scenes.title: A familiar channel.
narration: Hermes already supports Discord, Telegram, and Slack.
Configure a channel to reach your M2 from outside, while Herdr control stays local.
qualifications: Discord connectivity recorded; Telegram / Slack integration unverified.
Illustrative workflow · fresh end-to-end control not verified
scenes.visual: Official Discord, Telegram and Slack marks sit above an illustrative request. One message signal reaches Hermes; the Hermes-to-Herdr path stays inside the session.

scenes.title: No SSH required.
narration: No SSH. No remote desktop. No VPN or exposed Herdr control port.
Keep the host, Herdr, and gateway online.
qualifications: Configure channel access; messaging and model services must be reachable.
scenes.visual: The familiar channel remains outside the local session. A message crosses to Hermes while the Herdr control path stays inside. No decorative floor or shadow.

scenes.title: Visible. Pausable. Yours.
narration: The plugin ties the dedicated gateway to Herdr's lifecycle.
Pause stays paused until you resume. The monitor TUI shows its state.
qualifications: Lifecycle is implemented; full cold-start / exit integration remains unverified.
scenes.visual: The actual native monitor SVG appears without perspective or cropping beside simple lifecycle words. The data is an offline, fictional fixture.

scenes.title: Your profile. Your session.
narration: Herdr and plugin boundaries still apply.
Session binding is not an operating-system sandbox. Same-user terminal permissions remain broad.
qualifications: No arbitrary external authorization · No public control plane
scenes.visual: An unselected external Hermes remains outside. Only the chosen profile connects within the current-session outline; the OS-sandbox caveat remains explicit.

scenes.title: Take your weekend back.
narration: Let the system manage the talent.
Keep your judgment. Take your weekend back.
scenes.visual: Agent icons circulate around their managers while a flat yellow sunrise reveals SAT and SUN. The autonomous team and returned weekend share one clean composition.

scenes.title: hermes on herdr
narration: Hermes on Herdr. By Hexly AI.
scenes.visual: Published HexlyReveal, mark first and wordmark from 1.25 seconds. A consumer-scoped vertical clipping fix preserves the full y descender without changing official wordmark geometry or the immutable kit.
